name: bb-plugin-bench-provider-gcp
description: A BB plugin that lends Google Compute Engine VMs to bb-autoresearch as remote bench hosts, over your own gcloud CLI.
author: Pascal de Ladurantaye <pascal.de.ladurantaye@gmail.com>

bb.name: GCP Compute bench hosts
bb.description: Lends Google Compute Engine VMs to bb-autoresearch as remote bench hosts: creates self-deleting VMs with your gcloud login, moves files and runs processes over SSH.
